projects.title: Dozer Taser
projects.description: DozerTaser uses the smartphone’s front camera to monitor driver’s facial expressions in real time. If the app detects drowsiness, it will alert the driver (vibrate smartwatch, sound an alarm, ask questions) and text / call / email the emergency contact. The app also allows friends and family to create rewards to motivate their loved ones to drive safely.

projects.title: Prototype of Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU)
projects.description:
Designed, implemented and tested an innovative prototype of PMU in an FPGA.
The design included a novel phasor calculation algorithm, real-time, high-speed communications and modern power system monitoring protocols (IEEE c37.118).
Created a simulation environment using Matlab/Simulink (SimpowerSystems) to test the prototype.
Important improvements achieved in processing speed, size and cost of typical PMUs.
